candidates.rationale: Different geography and scale; onechat is a payment platform, not a Southeast Asian consumer internet/e-commerce conglomerate like Sea.

candidates.name: Mahalat Technologies
candidates.description: It matches because it connects local merchants and customers through an AI-powered commerce platform and offers fintech features like credit payments, which is similar to e-commerce plus financial services.
candidates.rationale: Different region and scale; local Moroccan commerce platform, not a comparable Southeast Asian consumer internet conglomerate.

candidates.name: E-Commerce Philippines, Inc.
candidates.description: It fits because it provides "B2B e-commerce platforms" and "E-Commerce Connectivity" that support digital business and marketplace-style commerce infrastructure.
candidates.rationale: Infrastructure provider, not a consumer internet marketplace like Shopee; different business model and buyer persona.

candidates.name: FintechWerx
candidates.description: It matches due to its "e-commerce technology company" positioning, with payment solutions, identity verification, and a platform connecting merchants and consumers.
candidates.rationale: Different scale and geography; FintechWerx is a fintech/e-commerce tech vendor, not a comparable consumer internet platform like Sea.

candidates.name: Tinkoff
candidates.description: It fits because Tinkoff is a "digital financial ecosystem built around customer needs" and includes consumer banking, payments, insurance, and lifestyle services similar to a super-app model.
candidates.rationale: Different primary business and geography: Tinkoff is a Russian financial services ecosystem, not a Southeast Asian consumer internet/e-commerce company.

candidates.name: 8B
candidates.description: It matches because it focuses on payments infrastructure with "Accept payments and disburse funds" and "E-Commerce" support across multiple geographies.
candidates.rationale: Payments infrastructure vendor, not a consumer internet/e-commerce platform like Sea; serves Sea-type companies rather than being one.

candidates.name: OVEL COIN
candidates.description: It fits loosely as a "DIGITAL PAYMENT SYSTEM, E-COMMERCE AND FINANCIAL SERVICES MULTI-BRAND PLATFORM," which overlaps with consumer internet commerce and financial services.
candidates.rationale: Too vague and appears unrelated; not a clear comparable consumer internet platform at Sea/Shopee scale or geography.

candidates.name: Dowsure
candidates.description: It matches because it is a global API platform for "cross-border e-commerce" and provides digital products and risk solutions for online sellers.
candidates.rationale: Dowsure is a fintech/risk platform for online sellers, not a comparable consumer internet marketplace, entertainment, and financial services company.

candidates.name: Virtual Gain Technologies Pvt Ltd
candidates.description: It fits because it includes an ecommerce platform "Markzon" and payment platforms like "Payzon" and "FynzonPay," aligning with consumer internet commerce and digital payments.
candidates.rationale: Smaller Indian tech vendor, not a comparable consumer internet platform at Sea/Shopee scale or regional market.

candidates.name: Rkylin Group
candidates.description: Rkylin Group fits as a consumer-internet and e-commerce services company because it offers "one-stop e-commerce service", "digital marketing", "financial service ecosystem", and "mobile social e-commerce" in its business scope.
candidates.rationale: Not a comparable consumer internet platform; appears to be an e-commerce services/marketing provider rather than a Shopee-like marketplace operator.
